transcript_history/Yule/133/2.json.speaker: Other
transcript_history/Yule/133/2.json.text: A month ago, our disciples went out to purchase materials and resources.

transcript_history/Yule/133/3.json.speaker: Other
transcript_history/Yule/133/3.json.text: While one team was on the way back,

transcript_history/Yule/133/3.json.speaker: Other
transcript_history/Yule/133/3.json.text: They were ambushed by cultivators from the blood shadow tower.

transcript_history/Yule/133/3.json.speaker: Other
transcript_history/Yule/133/3.json.text: The team narrowly held them off,

transcript_history/Yule/133/3.json.speaker: Other
transcript_history/Yule/133/3.json.text: But on their way back, they were attached at red water town.

transcript_history/Yule/133/3.json.speaker: Other
transcript_history/Yule/133/3.json.text: So they sent a distress message out.

transcript_history/Yule/133/5.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/5.json.text: I thought this town was supposedly attacked by demon cultivators, but this is it? Didn't the task say two Dao stage cultivators were sent here already?

transcript_history/Yule/133/5.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/5.json.text: But this is OK, I guess they were just making a bunch of fuss.

transcript_history/Yule/133/6.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/6.json.text: Hey, why don't you talk to us, I offered you food so that you could help us in this task.

transcript_history/Yule/133/6.json.speaker: Tuyết Ly
transcript_history/Yule/133/6.json.text: Yu le, did you order more?

transcript_history/Yule/133/6.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/6.json.text: Why would I? I'm full to bursting already.

transcript_history/Yule/133/7.json.speaker: Liễu Nguyệt Nhi
transcript_history/Yule/133/7.json.text: This is our treasured dish, the red water map hotpot.

transcript_history/Yule/133/7.json.speaker: Liễu Nguyệt Nhi
transcript_history/Yule/133/7.json.text: Who cares? Just by looking at you we can tell that you're from the SECT. We owe so much to the SECI, so this is on the house.

transcript_history/Yule/133/7.json.speaker: Tuyết Ly
transcript_history/Yule/133/7.json.text: It's so delicate, it shows a road without any people.

transcript_history/Yule/133/8.json.speaker: Liễu Nguyệt Nhi
transcript_history/Yule/133/8.json.text: That road is actually the spiritual vein of our town. Us mortals can't withstand that kind of spiritual energy, so if we try to have children there they will die prematurely, so no one lives there.

transcript_history/Yule/133/8.json.speaker: Liễu Nguyệt Nhi
transcript_history/Yule/133/8.json.text: But you cutivators don't have that concern? Why don't you free yourselves there? I have a special treasure that was hidden there by the adults before...

transcript_history/Yule/133/9.json.speaker: Thái Thư Lệ
transcript_history/Yule/133/9.json.text: Clueless about what? Is it fun? I'll take it instead!

transcript_history/Yule/133/9.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/9.json.text: As expected of the townspeople living under the Yuamo Sept, they're all weird.

transcript_history/Yule/133/9.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/9.json.text: We don't want whatever you're offering...

transcript_history/Yule/133/10.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/10.json.text: Who the hell are you? I don't know you!

transcript_history/Yule/133/10.json.speaker: Thái Thư Lệ
transcript_history/Yule/133/10.json.text: Yu le, is this girl a past romance? Good luck!

transcript_history/Yule/133/11.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/11.json.text: You're not the person sent by the Yuamo SECT?

transcript_history/Yule/133/11.json.speaker: Tuyết Ly
transcript_history/Yule/133/11.json.text: Has something to do with the task here?

transcript_history/Yule/133/12.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/12.json.text: You sent the distress message? Why did the men from the blood shadow tower attack you?

transcript_history/Yule/133/12.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/12.json.text: The distress message was sent by our leader. As for why we were attacked, I have no idea!

transcript_history/Yule/133/12.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/12.json.text: We didn't have any treasures, and we didn't have anyone with a grudge against them. I really don't know why they did it.

transcript_history/Yule/133/13.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/13.json.text: If it wasn't for the efforts of our leader, me and the other remaining two people would already be dead.

transcript_history/Yule/133/13.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/13.json.text: Our original plan was to hide in Red Water Town to make use of the Magic "Breath concealing" weapon until they left...

transcript_history/Yule/133/13.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/13.json.text: But we didn't expect them to hang around for so long, making it impossible for us to escape.

transcript_history/Yule/133/13.json.speaker: Tuyết Ly
transcript_history/Yule/133/13.json.text: Your leader seems different from most of the others in the SEC, he didn't make you sacrifice yourselves for him.

transcript_history/Yule/133/14.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/14.json.text: They're not all selfish people you know...

transcript_history/Yule/133/15.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/15.json.text: If your leader can block the enemies for so long, maybe they aren't that strong.

transcript_history/Yule/133/15.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/15.json.text: But we got told that two Dao stage cultivators came here and haven't returned yet? Did they make contact with you?

transcript_history/Yule/133/16.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/16.json.text: The Blood Shadow Tower cultivators are disguised as townspeddle here, maybe they weren't prepared...

transcript_history/Yule/133/16.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/16.json.text: Those two died because of me, so I had to hide to protect myself.

transcript_history/Yule/133/16.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/16.json.text: When I finally met them I realised I cannot back down.

transcript_history/Yule/133/17.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/17.json.text: I just want you to help us escape....

transcript_history/Yule/133/17.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/17.json.text: I can live a hardworking life by your side.

transcript_history/Yule/133/18.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/18.json.text: Please relax, we haven't been idle all this time here. We've picked up traces of the blood shadow tower cultivators around here...

transcript_history/Yule/133/18.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/18.json.text: The enemy is out in the open and we are in the shadows, we can ambush them!

transcript_history/Yule/133/19.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/19.json.text: Alright alright, I'll help, just get up!

transcript_history/Yule/133/19.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/19.json.text: According to our intelligence, they meet for a quarter of an hour every evening in a large house in the South West of the Town...

transcript_history/Yule/133/20.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/20.json.text: We can use this chance to take them all down at once in one strike!

transcript_history/Yule/133/20.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/20.json.text: I understand. Go back now, tell the other two.

transcript_history/Yule/133/21.json.speaker: Dư Y Ba
transcript_history/Yule/133/21.json.text: Then I'll see you later sir.

transcript_history/Yule/133/22.json.speaker: Tuyết Ly
transcript_history/Yule/133/22.json.text: That girl, she trusted us to be able to help her, without even asking about our cultivation level.

transcript_history/Yule/133/22.json.speaker: Thái Thư Lệ
transcript_history/Yule/133/22.json.text: What do you plan to do?

transcript_history/Yule/133/22.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/22.json.text: We have to go there, after all it's the only lead we have.

transcript_history/Yule/133/22.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/22.json.text: Obviously we'll go! How can I miss this opportunity, it's certainly a death trap, how could I pass up this kind of opportunity?

transcript_history/Yule/133/23.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/23.json.text: I WANT TO KNOW SOMETHING FIRST!

transcript_history/Yule/133/23.json.speaker: Dư Lạc
transcript_history/Yule/133/23.json.text: You two must! Must! Definitely! Hide behind me, and don't risk yourselves!

transcript_history/Yule/133/25.json.speaker: Tuyết Ly
transcript_history/Yule/133/25.json.text: What's this smell? It's so good.
